name: 993 Turbo engine carrier, closed-section shape study (PicoGK)
material_candidate: unknown OEM steel; no grade qualified (density of steel used for the mass estimate only)
picogk_enhancement: Replaces the flat T-blade with a bowed closed rounded-box section (two half shells with proud seam flanges, as the FVD photos suggest raised edges) that flows into the end bosses through gusset-like blends, the failure-prone zone named by the 964/993 crack reports; two rimmed side openings and two drains vent and drain the closed section (corrosion, inspection). Shape study only: interfaces are not modelled.

overall_length_mm.note: FVD listing declares 600 x 50 x 50 mm (vendor claim, rounded, not measured); boss outer to boss outer here

overall_height_mm.note: FVD listing 600 x 50 x 50 mm; equals the 50 mm boss height of the Qwen F1 concept

overall_width_mm.note: FVD listing 600 x 50 x 50 mm; reached by the boss diameter below

vendor_mass_kg.note: vendor claim; reference only for the wall choice, not used by the geometry

boss_diameter_mm.note: end boss outer diameter chosen to fill the vendor 50 mm envelope (Qwen F1 used 40 mm); mount 993 375 049 05 interface unmeasured

boss_bore_mm.note: hypothetical end bore of the Qwen F1 concept (radius 6.5 mm); no matched axis, stud or tolerance

boss_recess_diameter_mm.note: boss-end recess, photos show recesses of unknown size

beam_height_mid_mm.note: section depth at mid span (deeper where the bracket loads it)

beam_bow_mm.note: upward bow of the centreline at mid span; the photos show a bowed blade, amount unknown

wall_mm.note: half-shell wall; F0 assumed 6 mm plate; no load case filled; with solid end bosses the steel estimate (about 3 kg) exceeds the 1.96 kg claim

seam_flange_thickness_mm.note: two flanges of the half shells, welded together

seam_flange_height_mm.note: flange height proud of the section

opening_offset_mm.note: two round openings seen on the FVD photos; position not measured

opening_rim_height_mm.note: rim height proud of the side wall

pad_length_mm.note: flat seat for engine bracket 993 115 103 52; the four M10 x 20 sites are not located, so no hole is drawn

pad_raise_mm.note: pad top above the beam top at mid span

drain_offset_mm.note: drain holes in the lower shell (corrosion documented at the rear mounts)

open_interfaces: engine bracket 993 115 103 52: four M10 x 20 attachment sites (PET) - centres, axes, bores, mating faces and tolerances unknown, not drawn
left engine mounting 993 375 049 05: end interface, axis, bore and mating face unknown (bore drawn is hypothetical)
right engine mounting 993 375 049 05: end interface, axis, bore and mating face unknown (bore drawn is hypothetical)
section, wall, material, joint (weld) specification and load cases unknown
status: F0 concept geometry - not fitted, not tested, not safe, not released, not a print file; SAFETY CRITICAL powertrain mount: shape study only, no structural claim, manufacture and fitting prohibited
